scope: Independent static source review of recovered 0601c8/06ecdc versus retained assembly and typed module-path/find source composition. Peer files were read only; no target or real native APIs executed.
observed_checks: 0601c8 NULL branch clears four represented fields without free; empty nonzero-capacity branch writes exactly one narrow NUL and clears length
0601c8 insufficient-capacity branch clears ownership before errno accessor, writes errno 34, clears capacity, preserves data and stale length, and never allocates/frees
0601c8 query MOVSXD and unsigned comparison, low DWORD signed fill capacity, zero-only result tests, signextended result-minus-one length and GetLastError/map/read-errno order match assembly
06ecdc forwards module and requests 261 WCHAR while rebuilt argv destination is 260 bytes; only zero API count is failure; failure maps LastError and does not select locale or write destination
06ecdc initializes borrowed fixed buffer with low DWORD capacity and zero length; discards fixed converter status; returns low DWORD length
PathEffects uses actual select_code_page_region, preserving UTF8 fast path/full-BOOL ANSI versus OEM decision and conditional PTD flag cleanup; module path has a mandatory explicit provider

SdkPathProvider uses decltype(GetModuleFileNameW) and caller-owned live 264-WCHAR span, default import binding and injected WINAPI test; it preserves count/full module bits and rejects NULL getter or capacity beyond its span
WildcardEffects delegates to actual typed SDK Session while inherited conversion and heap bridges call real recovered cores, not stand-in recalloc or conversion implementations

Integrated fixture lower reads include only provider-owned heap/borrowed live storage and live find filename spans; path scratch registered for both conversion passes; independent ownership and explicit find close maintained

Composition tests cover 3 codepage variants, actual mode1/mode2 argv publication and preserved failure state, wildcard dot skipping and no attribute filtering, no-match and failed-pattern conversion fallback, 0x100 FindNext success, heap/onexit growth/failure, error PTD and module fallback/capacity failure

validation_observed.note: Existing standalone receipts inspected; review did not rerun peer tests or execute native providers.

limitations: Normal-flow source reconstruction only; original ABI, SEH, uninitialized/truncated scratch behavior and complete DLL equivalence remain unproven

Production requires genuine memory, locale, conversion, heap/runtime providers and serialized access per scratch/session. Integrated native function pointers are fixtures; native OS enumeration/module-path calls were not executed
Direct negative tests for SdkPathProvider NULL getter and capacity-over-264 are absent in inspected root test version; code implements both explicit domains and this is not a behavior mismatch
